title: Compare and swap
hints: Load, compare, then Store is not atomic as a whole: another goroutine can store a larger value between your Load and your Store, and you overwrite it.
CompareAndSwap(old, new) stores new only if the value is still old, and reports whether it did. Retry in a loop until either your value isn't larger or the swap succeeds.
for { cur := m.v.Load(); if x <= cur || m.v.CompareAndSwap(cur, x) { return } }
